svg.title: Who Turned the Commits Into Fireworks? — Virtù contribution constellation
svg.desc: Virtù's real 52-week GitHub contribution calendar rendered as a dark constellation. Activity peaks erupt into staged fireworks and confetti before the scene resets.
svg.text: VIRTÙ // A STACKED DECK OF STARS
WHO TURNED THE COMMITS INTO FIREWORKS?
THE SKY WAS VERSION-CONTROLLED. THIS WAS THE FIRST MISTAKE.
